name: POST /api/empi/merges/:merge_id/unmerge - compensating reversal
description: Reverses a prior merge by writing a compensating merge record; the reversing persona comes from the JWT and reason (the only body field, optional) is recorded with it. Edge cases: the entire body is optional, so an empty POST is valid; an unknown merge_id throws 'empi: merge <id> not found' and surfaces as a 500 InternalError, NOT a 404; unmerging a merge that has already been reversed is not guarded at the route and produces either a second compensation row or an 'empi: unmerge failed' 500, so this is not a safe retry; reversal counts feed the EMPI reversal-rate metric.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in the form "Bearer <jwt>"
JWT signature invalid, malformed, or past its exp claim
the merge_id in the path matches no merge row — surfaced as a 500, not a 404
the compensating insert returns no row (e.g. the merge was already reversed)

testCases.name: Reverse a prior merge via compensating event

payload.reason: Merge reversed - records belong to distinct persons
